title: Detecting open orbits of faithful connected solvable actions with nontrivial unipotents by bounded generalized root subgroups in characteristic zero
author: Andriy Regeta; Immanuel van Santen
work: Characterizing smooth affine spherical varieties via the automorphism group
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 8 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.149
difficulty_reason: The cited rational quotient and solvable invariant-fraction results do not by themselves produce root subgroups of a prescribed common weight and arbitrarily large dimension. The author combines two equal-weight semi-invariants with a homogeneous additive action to construct the displayed replicated actions, and verifies faithfulness through the independence of their homogeneous powers. That same-weight replication construction supplies the unbounded family needed for the converse implication, together with the exact vector-field/root-subgroup comparison.
